summary: Frontend-only verification of 10 fix items on preview (production build). All 10 PASS. BUG 1: on SGH, uploaded a TEST PNG, starred it as cover, clicked Save: no 409, no 4xx responses, sheet closed, hero cover changed to v=5436f1fb. Reopened Edit, starred the original photo back, pressed Escape: hero went back to v=192a0040 without a page reload. Removed the added photo afterwards (DELETE 200); SGH is back to its single original photo and cover (version 68 -> 73 from the photo ops). 'Ye' was not touched. BUG 2: at 390px, scrolled the /reports hub to scrollY 1924, opened Hold Register: scrollY 0. Data Quality: scrollY 0. /customers scrolled to 2200 then opened a customer: scrollY 0. Shalini Thakur (BK-2627-2661): Next due shows 'Other charges · Due today · ₹6,35,936'. In Record payment with NEFT / RTGS the amount pre-fills 6,35,936 and the hint reads 'Open now ₹6,35,936 · settled oldest first'. Not submitted. Customer cards: statuses seen were 'DUE TODAY', 'DUE ON 26 NOV' and 'OVERDUE N DAYS'; no 'DUE NOW'. /payments: a search with no results shows 'No receipts match these filters' with receipts-clear-filters; clicking it clears the search and 20 receipts come back. /leads: title 'leads & visits.', summary '104 leads in pipeline · 1 follow-up due · 1 visit today'; the header has only the project filter and one primary 'New lead'; no Book visit button anywhere. Follow-up due tile = 1, same as the Admin Home tile '1 follow-up due' (singular). Sales Home: '42% of all flats · as shown to sales'. /reports: Project Statement caption 'pick one for its full statement · today'. /masters/m/bank-accounts: title 'bank accounts.', summary '1 entry · used across projects, bookings and payments · deactivating keeps history', one 'New bank account'. /projects: QA Photo Test / QAPT is gone (3 projects: GGV, SGH, YE).

ui_bugs.issue: Hidden bug (not on screen in this run): the text is '{d.followups.count || "No"} follow-ups due', which is never singular, so a count of 1 reads '1 follow-ups due'. HomeWidgets tiles already handle singular.

issues: Shows 'Due today' for other-charges bills dated 05 Apr 2026 and 16 May 2026, which are months in the past. This matches the requested spec, but the product owner may expect 'Overdue since'.
The 'Drawn on bank' placeholder is cut off ('Pick or type the').
The Home 'All projects' filter and the report filters on mobile still use native <select> controls instead of the Elite Select.

action_items: Optional: make HomeElite.jsx:207 singular ('1 follow-up due') to match HomeWidgets
Optional: fix the cut-off 'Drawn on bank' placeholder in PostPayment
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectDialog: close() builds onSaved({...p, ...photos, version: ver}), but ProjectWorkspace's onSaved ignores the argument and reloads, which is fine. Projects.jsx onSaved should also handle this payload shape.
